error.message:
schemaVersion: version 1 configuration is no longer supported, and Trail Guide doesn't convert it. Rewrite .trailguide/config.yaml as version 2, as in the example below: in each source, move groups and rules into rules.include, writing each group as its selector, such as techs/go/*, and keeping wildcards such as "*"; then move exclude and pins under rules as lists of entries with an id, writing each replacedBy as the ID of the authored rule it names, such as techs/go/our-errors for local/techs/go/our-errors.md. Move authored rules and groups from .trailguide/local/ to .trailguide/rules/, and shared assets from .trailguide/local/assets/ to .trailguide/assets/.

schemaVersion: 2
sources:
  team:
    repository: https://github.com/example/rules.git
    ref: release/3
    rules:
      include: [techs/go/*, practices/testing/verify-retry-limits]
      exclude:
        - id: techs/go/wrap-errors
          reason: Our errors package covers this.
      pins:
        - id: practices/testing/verify-retry-limits
          version: "1.3.0"
          reason: Waiting on the author's answer.

After rewriting it, run trailguide project check.
